newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends weaker, coffee, sugar move lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends weaker, coffee, sugar move lower.

text.p: COFFEE - May long liquidation before first notice day, worries cited over new grading rules. July off three at $1,597 at close.
COCOA - Sharply lower as spec, fund sales drive July through support levels. Ends 42 lower at 1,002 stg, all positions down.
SUGAR - Nearbys touch weaker, NY eyed before expiry. August pressured by trade sales, down 50 cents at $312.60 at 1605 GMT.
